messages:
nina: Support escalated an activation blockade for acct sunbeam-42. Customer hit a permissions error during dataset ingest for embeddings; onboarding hang. They're on a paid POC (30d) with a renewal conversation in 21 days.

liam (support): Logs show S3 403 when agent tries to write objects to bucket `sunbeam-ingest-eu`. We retried 3x, same error. Customer is mid-demo with a partner tomorrow.

sophie: Can you paste the error?

liam: ```
2025-04-01T15:02:04Z ERROR ingest: write failed: PUT https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/sunbeam-ingest-eu/parts/abc123 403 AccessDenied
CausedBy: RoleAssumptionError: sts:AssumeRole denied for arn:aws:iam::123456:role/redwood-ingest-role
```

mike: Sounds like the cross-account role wasn't consented by their infra. If they don't want to update IAM now we can fallback to our managed ingest proxy (us-east-1) but that requires data transit consent and could add latency/cost.

nina: Risk: renewal in 21d + demo tomorrow = high touch. Support asks for immediate mitigation. Suggestions: 1) temporary managed ingest proxy, 2) provide step-by-step IAM consent script for their infra team, 3) offer 1-hr enablement session during demo to keep momentum.

liam: I've opened SUP-7891 and flagged P1. Also attached customer's minimal IAM policy snippet in the ticket.

infra-bot: Ticket created: MGMT-PROXY-211. Requires infra-oncall approval for cross-region proxy route. ETA 40m.

sophie: Comms plan draft (short + customer-friendly):
- Acknowledge: "We're sorry for the interruption during your ingest."
- Explain immediate actions: "We can enable a temporary managed ingest proxy so your demo can proceed. This will not change your data retention policy — only a transient route for onboarding."
- Offer options: (A) Accept proxy until IAM role is updated, (B) Walk your infra team through the IAM consent now (we can do a 20-min session).
- Next steps: "If you choose proxy, we'll enable it within ~45 mins and confirm when your ingest completes. We'll follow with a root-cause postmortem and next steps to revert to native S3 ingest."

nina: Add a goodwill gesture: offer a one-month POC extension (or service credit) if activation isn't resolved before the renewal checkpoint. Need CS approval.

mike: Technical note: proxy will use encrypted transit and will store objects in a customer-specific bucket under our managed account with lifecycle TTL 7 days unless they opt out. Documented here: https://redwood.internal/security/data-transit-policy

liam: Customer asked: "Will this impact inference latency?" Quick answer: tiny bump during ingest, no impact to model latency once assets are loaded.

cs-bot: Escalation flagged: renewal-risk-high. Added to cs-tracker.

nina: Action items:
- @mike: confirm infra approval and estimated enable time, post here.
- @sophie: send comms template to customer ASAP when we have ETA.
- @liam: offer two slots for 20-min IAM walkthrough (tomorrow 09:00 CET or 13:00 CET).
- @cs-bot: mark account for renewal outreach if not resolved in 48h.

mike: Infra approved proxy; enabling now. Routing flip ETA 12 mins.

liam: Customer accepted proxy; asked for enablement at 13:00 CET. I scheduled and shared calendar invite.

sophie: Sent comms with option A/B + brief FAQ. Included one-slide enablement checklist and link to privacy note.

nina: Post-call notes: ingest completed, demo proceeded, customer appreciated transparency. They asked for a written RCA and to keep the POC extension as backup. I'll draft the RCA template and propose service credit if root cause is infra-consent friction.

mike: Revert plan: we'll revert to native S3 ingest after they confirm role consent and we've validated end-to-end in staging. Revert runbook in infra ticket.

nina: Closing escalation: all actions committed. Marking for follow-up RMS: 48h and RCA in 72h. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
